"''No mystery there. He's lucky he wasn't killed years ago. One of the most unpleasant people I've ever met.|Chief Inspector Hyne and Syril Karn, on Kravas Drezzer|audio=Hyne-Karn-Four-Kassa.flac|}} '''Morlana Four''' was an astronomical object in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Morlani system]], situated along the [[Hydian Way]]. It was under the control of the [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation]] until [[5 BBY]], when the [[Galactic Empire]] [[Takeover of the Preox-Morlana Corporate Sector|took over]] jurisdiction of the [[star system]]. ==Description== Morlana Four, also referred to simply as Four, was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the [[Morlani system]] of the [[Free Trade sector]], a [[Sector|subsector]] of the [[Xappyh sector]], within an intersecting portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories]] and [[New Territories]]. Situated in grid square Q-3 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]], it lay along the [[Hydian Way]] [[super-hyperroute]]{{BuildFalconCite|48|Guide to the Galaxy}} between the astronomical objects [[Listehol]] and [[Ruuria]]. ==History== {{Quote|As of this morning, the Morlana system is under permanent Imperial authority.|Blevin, to Hyne, Syril Karn, and [[Sergeant]] [[Linus Mosk]]|audio=Blevin-MorlanaSystem-Aldhani.flac|{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}}}} [[File:KravasDrezzer-CGSWG.png|thumb|right|220px|Morlana Four was the homeworld of Kravas Drezzer.]] During the [[Imperial Era|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], the [[Star system|Morlani system]] was [[Governor|governed]] by the [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation]]. Morlana Four was the [[homeworld]] of the [[human]] [[Kravas Drezzer]], who worked as a [[squad]] [[Commanding officer|commander]] for Preox-Morlana there before eventually becoming a [[Sentry Corporal]] on the [[planet]] [[Morlana One]]. After Drezzer and another [[Verlo Skiff|sentry guard]] were [[Death|killed]] in a [[Search for Kerri|fight]] on Morlana One in [[5 BBY]], [[Chief Inspector]] [[Hyne]] of the [[Pre-Mor Security Inspection team]] reviewed a report of the incident by [[Deputy Inspector]] [[Syril Karn]] and recognized the late sentry guard for his service on Morlana Four. Karn's investigation into the double murder led to an [[Ambush on Ferrix|incident]] that caught the Empire's attention, including the Free Trade sector's [[ISB Supervisor]] [[Blevin]]. Under Blevin's direction, jurisdiction over the Morlani system was [[Takeover of the Preox-Morlana Corporate Sector|rescinded]] to the Empire.{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}} ==Behind the scenes== Morlana Four was first mentioned as "Four" in "[[Kassa (episode)|Kassa]]," the first episode in the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', that aired on [[September 21]], [[2022]].{{InsiderCite|217|Star Wars: Andor Season One Companion|''Star Wars: Andor'' Season One Companion}} Morlana Four's full name was first given in the [[2024]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''. ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}} {{1stm}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' {{1stID|Morlana Four}} *''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Morlana Cuatro |ja=モーラーナ4 |ka=მორლანა ოთხი |nl=Morlana Four |tr=Dört }} [[Category:Astronomical objects in the New Territories]] [[Category:Astronomical objects in the Outer Rim Territories]] [[Category:Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation locations]] [[Category:Morlani system locations]] [[Category:Terrestrial astronomical objects]]
